source: MEASURED TRULY-BLIND run — browser-only, no source read, hardened fixture, run-id blind-final, 2026-09-01
_attribution: Truly blind (agent never read source/comments). Caught F1,F2,F3,J2,H1,U1,U2,U3. MISSED F4(negative),J1(Ghost),J3(every-3rd),J4(0-share toast),U4(? console/name) — the seeds the leaky-fixture runs had been hinted toward. BUG-004(non-integer),BUG-006(re-finalize),BUG-010(page2) are real unseeded defects.

findings.text: BUG-001: Ownership % ignores the 500,000-share ESOP pool entirely (shows shares/totalIssued, not shares/(totalIssued+pool))
BUG-002: SAFE amount rounds down instead of round-half-up on an exact half-cent
BUG-003: totalIssued (cached) goes stale after deleting a founder -- not recomputed
BUG-004: Add-founder accepts non-integer (decimal) share counts
BUG-005: Finalize round flips status to COMPLETE but never writes captable:holdings
BUG-006: Re-finalizing an already-COMPLETE round reports false success
BUG-007: Archive founder is non-functional -- no UI affordance exists to select a founder, and the button no-ops
BUG-008: Multiple WCAG AA contrast failures (helper text, section heading, help button, success toast)
BUG-009: '?' help button is 16x16px, below the WCAG 2.2 24x24 minimum target size
BUG-010: Navigating to page2.html via the real 'Go to page 2' link throws a console error and a failed network request
BUG-011: SAFE-note Amount table cell/header unintentionally clips its content (text-overflow:clip, not ellipsis)
